facts.text: The hotel is on Knightsbridge, immediately adjacent to Hyde Park.
facts.excerpt: It now offers contemporary luxury and traditional glamour in one of London’s most prestigious locations, immediately adjacent Hyde Park on Knightsbridge.

facts.text: The building began its life as the Hyde Park Corner Tube station.
facts.excerpt: The building began its life as the Hyde Park Corner tube station, which was designed by Leslie Green.

facts.text: The station's facade remains part of the hotel, and the ox-blood tiles on the front of the building are the originals.
facts.excerpt: It closed in 1937, but the façade still remains as part of the hotel, and the ox-blood tiles used on the front of the building are the originals.

facts.text: The building is the former home of the jazz and cabaret venue Pizza on the Park.
facts.excerpt: is also the former home of iconic jazz and cabaret venue, Pizza on the Park.

facts.text: The hotel is named after Sir Arthur Wellesley, the first Duke of Wellington.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is named after Sir Arthur Wellesley, the first Duke of Wellington.

facts.text: The design by Fox Linton Associates is a modern take on the Art Deco style that acknowledges the building's jazz legacy.
facts.excerpt: The design by Fox Linton Associates acknowledges the potent association with the building’s decadent jazz musical legacy and has been beautifully restored with a modern take on the art-deco style.

facts.text: The Wellesley Penthouse occupies the sixth and seventh floors and can be booked as a one, two or four bedroom option.
facts.excerpt: The sixth and seventh floors of the hotel are given over to the beautiful Wellesley Penthouse that can be enjoyed as a one, two and four bedroom option.

facts.text: The Churchill Suite, part of the Penthouse, has its own winding staircase to a private terrace with rooftop views over Belgravia.
facts.excerpt: The Churchill Suite, part of The Wellesley Penthouse, features its own winding staircase leading onto a private terrace offering unique rooftop views over Belgravia and further South-West London

facts.text: The Park View Suites, Junior Suites and One Bedroom Suites, offer views over Hyde Park.
facts.excerpt: Our Park View Suites offer spectacular views over Hyde Park. Choose from our elegant Junior Suites or the spacious One Bedroom Suites

facts.text: The bathrooms use veined Arabescato Corchia marble hand-selected in Italy and have televisions recessed into mirrored walls.
facts.excerpt: The designers took several trips to Italy to hand select the blocks and slabs of the beautiful veined Arabescato Corchia marble from the Cararra region. The bathrooms feature televisions recessed into mirrored walls.

facts.text: A 24-hour butler service, including unpacking, pressing and shoe shining, is complimentary to all guests.
facts.excerpt: Butler service is complimentary to all guests. Our 24-hour butler service includes unpacking, pressing, shoe shining and room service.

facts.text: The concierge team is Les Clefs d'Or and can help create a bespoke itinerary.
facts.excerpt: Les Clefs d'Or team members provide a wealth of information to all guests visiting London and can help create a bespoke itinerary.

facts.text: Guests get a complimentary chauffeur drop-off within a 1.5 mile radius in a BMW 7 Series hybrid.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary luxury chauffeur drop-off service within a 1.5 mile radius with our BMW 7 series hybrid.

facts.text: The Oval Restaurant serves refined Italian cuisine from fresh, seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Head Chef Damiano Licciardello creates refined Italian cuisine from fresh, seasonal ingredients.

facts.text: The heated Cigar Terrace has leather seats and a bespoke humidor of fine cigars.
facts.excerpt: The heated Cigar Terrace and its inviting leather seats provide exceptional experiences for cigar aficionados and novices in all weather conditions. A bespoke humidor houses a connoisseur's selection of only the finest cigars.

facts.text: The Crystal Bar's walls display whisky, cognac and Armagnac collections, including some extremely rare bottles from 1770.
facts.excerpt: The walls of the lavish Crystal Bar are adorned with glass unique display cases containing The Wellesley’s impressive selections of whisky, cognac and armagnac collections, including a number of extremely rare bottles from 1770.

facts.text: The two bedroom Family Suite includes children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities, and babysitting can be arranged with the concierge.
facts.excerpt: Relax into a two bedroom Family Suite, which includes our 24-hour Butler service, children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities. Baby sitting services can be arranged on request with our Concierge.

facts.text: Parking is off-site, at a nearby Q Park.
facts.excerpt: Off-site self parking is available near The Wellesley Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel, London at Q Park.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Wellesley Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel, London.

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at The Wellesley Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel, London do not have a fridge.

facts.text: The humidor holds one of the most extensive selections of cigars outside Cuba.
facts.excerpt: Our bespoke Humidor holds one of the most exclusive and extensive selections of cigar outside Cuba.
